title: Successor transition coherence for finite open scalar comparison
statement: For operations o, tensor comparison tc, scalar compatibility sc, and a family level of degreewise comparison isomorphisms satisfying the component formula, the two composites formed from the unrestricted successor transitions and level are equal in every complex degree.

proof.text: Evaluate both chain-map composites on sheafified pure tensors generating each unrestricted reduction. The generator formula for the finite comparison, the section formula for the scalar compatibility map, and naturality of extension by zero reduce both sides to the same coefficient transition; uniqueness of the unrestricted transition then gives equality.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarComparisonTransition
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (tc : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o)
    (sc : ScalarCompatibility l E j o)
    (level : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ),
      (unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E X n).obj
          ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).obj Q) ≅
        (OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).obj
          ((unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E U n).obj Q))
    (components : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ)
      (i : ℤ),
      ((level n Q).hom.f i) =
        (scalarReductionRestriction l E X n).map ((tc.ordinary n).hom.app (Q.X i)) ≫
          (sc.finite n).hom.app ((scalarReductionExtension l E U n).obj (Q.X i))) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ) (i : ℤ),
      ((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E X n).app
        ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).obj Q)).f i ≫
          (level n Q).hom.f i =
        (level (n + 1) Q).hom.f i ≫
          ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).map
            ((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E U n).app Q)).f i
